title: The Main Street Comedy Show Storytelling and Improv
includes: Ticket to the Main Street Comedy Show
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: The Main Street Comedy Show is a delightful mix of storytelling and improv comedy that you do not want to miss! Each week a featured storyteller will delight the audience with true tales and then the talented team of improvisers create inspired and amazing, spontaneous comedy!
